messages:
maria_cs: Heads-up: Cedar Harbor preflight for the private/VPC deploy tomorrow. Quick check — outstanding items I have: 1) firewall / SG + LB health checks, 2) IAM/service account perms for the node service, 3) KMS/BYOK policy & rotation, 4) audit log delivery (S3 vs forwarding). Customer asked about retention and who can rotate keys. @aj_devops / @sri_security mind taking a quick look?

aj_devops: I can take firewall + LB. Need the outbound CIDR you'll allow for model updates/metrics. For now plan: allow 443 (TLS) to Redwood endpoints, 8443 for internal LB health, ephemeral 10250 for kube probes. Quick SG snippet: ```aws ec2 authorize-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-0123456789abcdef --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 203.0.113.0/24``` Will that CIDR work?

kelly_customer: We can allow 203.0.113.0/24 for outbound to Redwood. Also we'll want all audit logs put to a customer S3 bucket (s3://cedar-logs/redwood) with 90d retention before lifecycle archive. BYOK: we can provide a KMS ARN: arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:111122223333:key/abcd-ef01-2345. Who needs access?

sri_security: Thanks Kelly. For BYOK we need the key policy to include the Redwood service principal plus any customer roles that will manage rotation. Minimal policy example: ```{ "Sid":"AllowRedwoodUse", "Effect":"Allow", "Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/redwood-service"]}, "Action":["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"], "Resource":"*" }``` We'll coordinate exact principal with @jake_se. Note: you can keep automatic rotation on or off; we support both workflows.

jake_se: Confirming our service principal: arn:aws:iam::444455556666:role/redwood-service. For S3 delivery we need a bucket policy that allows PutObject and kms:Encrypt for the same principal. Quick reference: https://docs.redwood.ai/private/s3-audit-ingest. Also recommend enabling S3 Object Lock or bucket lifecycle for retention compliance.

kelly_customer: Copy on principals. We'll update KMS key policy and the bucket policy tonight. About key rotation: we want monthly rotation — can Redwood rotate keys or do we need to rotate and re-encrypt objects ourselves? Concern: rotation may cause brief mismatches for cached tokens.

maria_cs: Short answer: we support managed key rotation with a coordinated maintenance window. If you prefer to rotate keys yourself, we'll need you to swap the key alias and notify us so we can update references. I'll schedule a 30-min enablement with your SREs tomorrow 10:00–10:30 ET. Does that work? :calendar: 

kelly_customer: 10:00 ET works for our SREs. One more ask: during onboarding can we get a runbook for incident escalation and an SLA matrix to share with infra ops?

maria_cs: Yep — I'll post the runbook and SLA doc in this thread after the enablement. Added a short checklist for final acceptance: 1) SG rules confirmed, 2) KMS policy updated, 3) S3 bucket policy + lifecycle set, 4) enablement session completed, 5) test ingest + audit log verification. @aj_devops can you run the test ingest once the KMS policy is updated?

aj_devops: :thumbsup: will run the test and post logs. Plan to run it at 22:00 PT tonight and report back.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled job redwood/cs/test-ingest started 1793005000 — logs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-test-logs/cedar/1793005000.log

aj_devops: Test completed — uploaded logs and confirmed objects encrypted with the provided KMS. Failing a small number of health checks due to 8443 being blocked by our corporate FW; Kelly can you confirm opening 8443 inbound from our LB IP 198.51.100.45?

kelly_customer: Opening 8443 for 198.51.100.45 now. Also confirming lifecycle rule for 90d. Thanks all.

maria_cs: Great — I'll mark this ready for final handoff and send a renewal-facing health note: onboarding green, low renewal risk if enablement completes. Wrapping up with docs after the session. :white_check_mark:
